[[File:Starcrossed.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Both the yacht ''Starcrossed'' (pictured) specifically and yachts in general were referred to as pleasure boats.]]
A '''pleasure boat''' was a term used to refer to either a type of [[Atmosphere/Legends|wind]]-driven [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Boat/Legends|vehicle]]<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> or a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that included [[Yacht/Legends|yachts]].<ref name="Pirates">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref>
